name: data-2026-09-28
_comment: The data release being built. Each release is a frozen snapshot (PLATO 0.5.0: a published gazetteer is append-only), so a rebuild takes a NEW name here and is uploaded as a NEW GitHub release; an uploaded release is never replaced. Read by export_plato.py (gazetteer version header), export_records.py and build_downloads.py.
